Name: Example — Elevation Reveal
Description: The camera starts low, near the Mandelbulb's equator (phi 0.05), and rises up and over the top (phi 1.45) while orbiting a half-turn. Distance holds roughly constant. This is the elevation (phi) axis on its own, showing how vertical parallax makes a camera move read as flying around a solid object rather than the object spinning. Catmull-Rom keeps the rise smooth.
